title: García Márquez: a writer and journalist from Colombia
goal: Talk about García Márquez and his work with stance adverbs (*en realidad*, *en rigor*, *afortunadamente*).
grammar: stance adverbs, applied to García Márquez

items: I can comment on a fact with a stance adverb such as *en realidad*, *en rigor* or *afortunadamente*.
I can give the main dates of García Márquez: 1927, 1955, 1967 and 1982.
I can use the new words for an account, a castaway, a prize and a trait.
